Title: Azure Cost Management multi-cloud for AWS is in preview

Body.Content:
Azure Cost Management for AWS is now in public preview, allowing you to manage your AWS and Azure spend right in the same service so you can get insights easily and find ways to optmize. Features like cost analysis and budgets are availble as part of this feature as well, helping simplify your cost management practice on multi-cliud scenarios.

Learn More
